name: Remove Passkey
summary: An authenticated user removes one selected passkey owned by the current durable identity and remains on Passkey Management with the refreshed credential list.

preconditions.expression: user is authenticated and at least one removable passkey belongs to the current durable identity

serverInteraction.intent: Delete only the selected passkey credential after proving it belongs to the current durable user and relying party, then reload the user's passkey list.

postconditions.expression: the selected passkey no longer exists for the current durable identity; other credentials and the active authenticated identity are unchanged
